findings.review: No exterior metal tube, circular bore, rim or cannon muzzle remains. The main wall aperture is a dark empty masonry passage. Interior breech, visible barrel and wooden carriage remain, with the forward end concealed behind stone. Both additional secondary openings remain. External alpha and warm stone/brick palette checked.
findings.limits: No claim of solving the rejected hidden cannon geometry: its muzzle is intentionally not shown. Conceptual cutaway, not a measured reconstruction. Fine texture disappears at small sizes.
